description: Plays an internet radio stream into the patch, from an mp3, pls or m3u address

params.text: Starts and stops the stream at the address typed in
Sets the level of the stream, from silence to three times

outputs.text: The left channel of the stream
The right channel of the stream

notes: nothing plays until an address is typed in: click the display above the GAIN knob, type the address of an mp3 stream or of a pls or m3u playlist, then press the button beside it
the two bars below the display show how much of the stream has been fetched and how much audio is decoded and waiting
